statement: Recorded BEFORE any scored cell ran. At freeze time NO cell existed and NO scored number had been produced or read, so nothing in this amendment can have been influenced by a result. The gate job running at the time of the base freeze uses rv8_horizon.py only; it does not import or execute rv8_analyse.py.

defect_found_pre_execution.name: the analysis loaded all 984 cells into memory at once
defect_found_pre_execution.evidence: 984 cells x up to 131,072 tasks x 4 per-task arrays is order 5e8 Python ints, roughly 20 GB; the analysis would have died on the full grid
defect_found_pre_execution.attribution: analysis I/O stage: load() materialised every cell before any computation
defect_found_pre_execution.lever: CellStore -- lazy per-cell load with a cache released after each (mix, composition) group, and a single pass per group computing surface, ladder, windows and null together instead of four separate passes

semantic_changes_to_endpoints: NONE. Every endpoint, statistic, CI rule, pairing rule, horizon ladder and null comparison is unchanged. Two additions, both pre-execution and both purely additive: (1) 'horizon_reached_max' and 'all_seeds_complete' are reported per surface row so an incomplete cell is never read as a complete one; (2) a free internal determinism check -- at mix 1.0 the 'balanced' and 'f1_only' compositions are the SAME stream because the non-F2 remainder is empty, so their cells must agree exactly, and the check is reported as mix1_composition_identity_check.
corrected_before_freeze_too: the critical-mix CI orientation: saving/task rises with mix, so the UPPER CI bound on saving crosses zero at the SMALLEST mix and therefore gives the LOWER bound on the critical mix. The first draft had the two bounds swapped. Corrected before any scored cell.
unchanged_from_base_freeze: axes (horizon ladder, mix grid, compositions, seeds)
